description_en: Checks the status and availability of a short link
description_zh: 查询短链状态，可判断短链是否可用
name: QueryShortUrl

parameters.description_en:
The short link to query. Obtain this URL by calling the [AddShortUrl](~~186774~~) API.

><notice>

This API is not currently supported by Short Message Service.

></notice>
parameters.description_zh:
生成的短链服务地址。可通过[AddShortUrl](~~186774~~)接口获取。
><notice>短信服务暂时不支持使用此接口。></notice>
